info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Product Management Special Pricing Condition-spec
info.description: This API allows businesses to manage special pricing conditions for their products efficiently. It enables the creation of tailored pricing strategies based on various criteria, ensuring competitive offerings in the market. Typical consumers of this API include product managers and pricing analysts who need to streamline pricing across diverse product lines. The API supports a flexible and dynamic approach to pricing, driving improved customer engagement and profitability.

post.summary: Create a new special pricing condition.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new special pricing conditions for products. By submitting the required details, a new pricing condition will be added to the product management system, facilitating better pricing strategies for specific customer segments.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create or update special pricing conditions for products in the system. It requires details regarding the pricing adjustments, including applicable product identifiers and the terms of the pricing conditions.
